findings.summary: Imprint-year route lookup is duplicated across library result components.
findings.consequence: The same guarded year-to-route lookup policy must stay synchronized across all, browse, download, latest, and source-download renderers; a future change to chronology route behavior can drift between views.
findings.evidence: The owned line creates a component-local computed Map from props.imprintYearTargets. The same imprintYearTargetsByYear, hasImprintYearTarget, and imprintYearTo pattern is present in LibraryAllResults.vue, LibraryBrowseResults.vue, LibraryDownloadResults.vue, and LibraryLatestResults.vue, all using LibraryImprintYearTarget.
findings.recommendation: Extract a small shared helper or composable for LibraryImprintYearTarget arrays, returning hasTarget(year) and to(year), and reuse it in the result components while preserving parent target construction.
